Take virus incidence recording thrice: First inspection at 8 to 10 weeks after planting and second inspection after 4 to 6 weeks after first inspection for virus symptoms and the third and final inspection 4 to 6 weeks after the second inspection .
method.formula: Number of virus infected or symptomatic plants in a plot divided by total number of plants in a plot times 100.

Predominant severity per plot must be registered at least thrice : 8 to 10 weeks after planting, 4 to 6 weeks after first scoring and the last scoring at 4 to 6 weeks after the second scoring
method.formula: Estimate mean virus severity by summing severity scores >1 in a plot divided by total number of symptomatic plant

Count anthracnose disease ?blight? or  leaf spot affected plants in plot twice (First inspection at 10 to 12 weeks post planting and second inspection after 2 to 4 weeks before harvesting ) and compute the proportion of damanged
method.formula: Number of infected plants in a plot divided by total number of plants in a plot times 100. OR Sum of the proportion of leaf area damage of N plants in plot divided by N

observationVariableName: yam anthracnose disease severity estimation in 1-5

trait.description: Anthracnose severity caused by the pathogen Colletotricum gloeosporioides. The reaction of plants in a plot to anthracnose infestation (blight or leaf spot) under screenhouse or in the field under natural infestation or artificial inoculation

method.description: Observe relative or absolute area of plant tissue affected by yam anthracnose disease and record the severity as a proportion or percentage of plant surface affected.It is visual score in scale under screenhouse, artificial inoculation or under field natural infestation. For artificial inoculation use a suspension of three most virulent strains of Colletothrichum gloeosporioides and inoculate the plants raised from vine cutting in vertical sack or other means by spraying. For natural infestation, scores can be taken 10 to 12 weeks after planting and second scoring about 4-6 weeks before harvesting . Artificial inoculation should be scored at 3 days after inoculation(DAI) , and repeated at 7DAI, 11DAI and 15DAI
method.formula: Estimate mean anthrancose severity by summing severity scores >1 in a plot divided by total number of symptomatic plant

categories: 1= No visible symptoms of anthracnose disease or infection spot on the leaf surface
2= Few anthracnose spots or sysmptoms on 1 t0 ~25% of the plant. One or two spots of less than 1 cm diameter width, and dry tissue on the leaf surface

3= Anthracnose symptoms covering ~26 t0 ~50% of the plant. One or two spots of more than 1 cm diameter width, and dry tissue on the leaf surface. Small dark and no dried spots with more than 1 cm width, are present

4= Symptom on >51% of the plant. Coalesced spots with dry tissue and covering a signifcant proprotion of the leaf surface. Areas with less than 1 cm width are coalescing to bigger spots also. Yellowing of green tissue is intense around the spots areas.

5=Severe necrosis and death of the plant. Coalesced spots with dry tissue more than 1.5 cm of diameter and covering a great proprotion of the leaf surface. Yellowing of the gree tissue is generalised in the leaf blade.

trait.description: Maximum ground cover

method.methodName: Subplot maximum ground cover from weekly image analysis - Computation
method.description:
Averaged maximum ground cover over two subplots. 
Ground cover computed from weekly images analysis. 
Maximum ground cover computed from ground cover dynamic modeled using time to event Beta Growth model.
method.reference:
Yin X, Goudriaan J, Lantinga EA, Vos J, Spiertz HJ. 2003. Ann Bot. 91(3): 361-71.
Ritz, C., Pipper, C., Yndgaard, F., Fredlund, K., Steinrucken, G., 2010. Eur. J. Agron. 32, 155–161.

observationVariableName: Crop vigor computation in days from median emergence to 80% of maximum ground cover

trait.description: Duration from median emergence to 80% of maximum ground cover

method.methodName: Duration from median emergence to 80% of maximum ground cover of subplot - Computation
method.description:
Averaged crop vigor expressed in days from median emergence to 80% of maximum ground cover in subplots.
Ground cover computed from weekly images analysis. 
Time at 80% of maximum growth computed via inverse regression of time to event Beta ground cover dynamic model.
method.formula:
Fraction_of_Emerged_Sprouts_at_time_t=Maximum_Emergence_Fraction/(1+exp(-Slope_Around_Inflection_Point*(log(t)-log(Median_Emergence_Time))
Time_From_Emergence=Nb_Of_Days_Since_Planting-Median_Emergence_Time
Ground_Cover=Maximum_Ground_Cover*(1+(Time_From_Emergence_To_Maximum_Ground_Cover-Time_From_Emergence)/(Time_From_Emergence_To_Maximum_Ground_Cover-Time_At_Inflection_Point))*(Time_From_Emergence/Time_From_Emergence_To_Maximum_Ground_Cover)^(Time_From_Emergence_To_Maximum_Ground_Cover/(Time_From_Emergence_To_Maximum_Ground_Cover-Time_At_Inflection_Point))
Time_At_80%_Ground_Cover computed via inverse regression of Ground_Cover model using Ground_Cover=80%
method.reference:
Yin X, Goudriaan J, Lantinga EA, Vos J, Spiertz HJ. 2003. Ann Bot. 91(3): 361-71.
Ritz, C., Pipper, C., Yndgaard, F., Fredlund, K., Steinrucken, G., 2010. Eur. J. Agron. 32, 155–161.

trait.description: Crop cover compactness

method.methodName: Ratio between subplot ground cover area and its respective convex hull area - Computation
method.description:
Averaged crop cover compactness over two subplots images around time of 50% of maximum ground cover.
Ground cover computed from weekly images analysis. 
Time at 50% of maximum growth computed via inverse regression of time to event Beta ground cover dynamic model. 
Images choosen as near as possible of date of time at 50% of maximum growth .
Compactness computed as the ration between ground cover area (pixels) and its respective convex hull area (pixels).
method.formula:
Ground_Cover=Maximum_Ground_Cover*(1+(Time_From_Emergence_To_Maximum_Ground_Cover-Time_From_Emergence)/(Time_From_Emergence_To_Maximum_Ground_Cover-Time_At_Inflection_Point))*(Time_From_Emergence/Time_From_Emergence_To_Maximum_Ground_Cover)^(Time_From_Emergence_To_Maximum_Ground_Cover/(Time_From_Emergence_To_Maximum_Ground_Cover-Time_At_Inflection_Point))
Inverse regression of Ground_Cover model using Ground_Cover=50%
Ratio between crop ground cover  area (pixels) and its respective convex hull area (pixels)
method.reference:
Pateiro-Lopez B, Rodriguez-Casal A. 2010. Journal of Statistical Software. 34(5).
Yin X, Goudriaan J, Lantinga EA, Vos J, Spiertz HJ. 2003. Ann Bot. 91(3): 361-71.
Ritz, C., Pipper, C., Yndgaard, F., Fredlund, K., Steinrucken, G., 2010. Eur. J. Agron. 32, 155–161.
